principle.name: IMPACT_CREATED_TOOL_SUPPORT_RELEASE_DEBT
principle.pocket_rule: THE TOOL BECOMES A LEG AT IMPACT. THE BODY MUST STOP USING IT AS SUPPORT BEFORE THE TOOL CAN FLY AGAIN.

tango.judgment: Byte-identical reconstruction of all 33 displayed frames confirms a readable support-topology transaction: K05 pins the tool to ground, K06 carries pelvis overrun while rear support leaves, K07-K08 regrip and return two-foot ownership before K09 release, and K10-K15 pay rebound through overshoot, hand/shoulder lag, support reentry, and displaced settle. No authored mutation earned.

noodle_queen.taste: The impact changes the tool's job from weapon to temporary architecture, creating a specific and memorable silhouette problem.
noodle_queen.function: Tool-ground acquisition, root overrun, foot-support handoff before release, rebound overshoot, secondary lag, and displaced recovery remain visibly distinct in the actual final render.
noodle_queen.contempt: Rejects the cheap bounce-back: the tool cannot fly until the feet take the body back, and recovery never rewinds the strike.
